name: Kaioken Modelport
summary: Kaioken Modelport is the structural module for kaioken/modelport, providing a portable model-client abstraction that decouples LLM calls from vendor-specific APIs. It defines a ModelClient interface with complete/completeStream methods, a PiAiClient implementation with retry logic and model resolution, concurrency-limiting utilities with free-tier enforcement, token and cost estimation, and JSON extraction helpers. The module is designed for multi-provider support, cost control, and resilience through retryable-error classification and bounded concurrency.
keyPoints: Central abstraction: ModelClient interface (port.ts) with required complete() and optional completeStream(), implemented by PiAiClient (piai.ts) which adds model resolution, retry policy, and streaming with error classification via isRetryable().

Concurrency management (pool.ts): DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY=4, FREE_TIER_CONCURRENCY=2; isFreeModel() detects free-tier specs and clamps concurrency; mapLimit and mapLimitSettled provide bounded parallel execution.

Cost-aware estimation (spend.ts): token estimates per stage (plan: 25k, cards: 12k, wiki: 30k, update: 18k, research: 40k, skillgen: 15k), multiplier-based expansion, resolveRates() computes cost rates from ModelCost, and describeSpend() formats a human-readable summary.

Robust parsing utilities (port.ts): parseMultiplier() accepts string/number, clamped to [1,10]; depthFor() maps multiplier to a Depth; extractJson() uses balancedSpan() to handle nested JSON in LLM replies.

Extensive test coverage (test/): piai.test.ts stubs models and verifies client behavior, spend.test.ts validates cost calculations with a fixed flashCost, and port.test.ts exercises parsing functions; package.json and tsconfig.json mark the module structure.

entryPoints.name: ModelClient
entryPoints.note: Interface forcing complete(), optional completeStream(); the core contract for all model providers.

entryPoints.name: PiAiClient
entryPoints.note: Concrete ModelClient implementation with model resolution, retry policy, and streaming.

entryPoints.name: estimateSpend
entryPoints.note: Converts token estimates into cost using ModelCost rates; key for budgeting.

entryPoints.name: mapLimit
entryPoints.note: Runs async operations with a concurrency limit; used to control parallel model calls.

entryPoints.name: extractJson
entryPoints.note: Parses JSON from model text output, handling nested structures via balancedSpan.
